summary: 低空探测雷达是无人机防控领域的探测设备，是一款方位机扫、俯仰维相扫的脉冲多普勒体制三坐标雷达，主要用于对低空飞行器进行探测定位。该雷达可以精确探测目标的空间位置，可与干扰、导航诱骗等反制设备级联。 图1低空探测雷达
summary_en: This low-altitude detection radar is a 3D pulse Doppler radar using mechanical scanning for azimuth and electronic phase scanning for pitch. Primarily used for the detection and positioning of low-altitude aircraft, it precisely determines target spatial coordinates and can be connected with neutralization equipment such as jammers or navigation spoofers for integrated defense.
key_application: 应用领域：采用固态有源收发系统设计和数字信号处理技术，可靠性、安全性、保障性、测试性、可操作性、可维修性程度高。；具有全方位、全天候、全天时的目标自动检测和追踪能力。；支持夜晚、雨、雪、大雾等条件下正常工作。
key_application_en: 3D Pulse Doppler technology for precise spatial tracking; 360° azimuth search with zero detection blind spots; industrial-grade solid-state transceiver for all-weather reliability; multi-device automated defense network support.
key_parameter_1: 周扫探测范围: 方位：0~360°俯仰：0~30°
key_parameter_2: 整机重量: ≤66kg(不含三角支架，不含防雨罩)

parameters.探测距离: ≥10km（大疆精灵四）; ≥7km（白鹭） (虚警率：10-6，检测概率：85%)
parameters.自检能力: 实时分系统工作状态监控

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 3D三坐标雷达体制：采用脉冲多普勒技术，可同时提供高精度的距离、方位与俯仰信息。
  • 全天候大范围防御：方位360°无死角覆盖，适应风雨雷电及各类复杂气候干扰。
  • 多目标处理能力：支持对200个以上目标的同时探测、识别与稳定追踪。
  • 工业级高可靠性：固态有源架构，具备自动化故障辅助诊断与极高的平均无故障时间。
  • 多级联动响应：专为察打一体系统设计，输出标准UDP协议，一键联动反制设备。
  • 精密弱小目标检测：针对低慢小目标优化算法，有效过滤海浪、云图等环境杂波。
  • Figure 1 Low-Altitude Detection Radar
detail_html_en:
Features

  • 3D Coordinate tracking: utilizes Pulse Doppler and 3rd gen radar tech for precise range, azimuth, and altitude measurement.
  • Complete airspace coverage: mechanical 360° scanning ensures zero blind spots in protected areas.
  • High target density: autonomously tracks and classifies over 200 items simultaneously without capacity loss.
  • Military-grade reliability: modular solid-state transceiver design with IP-rated protection and real-time self-diagnostic systems.
  • Interoperability: natively exports standard data protocols for seamless integration with jammers and command & control platforms.
  • Environment optimization: advanced signal processing suppresses ground and weather clutter for superior accuracy.
category_primary: Anti-Drone / C-UAS Systems (反无人机系统)
category_tertiary: Low-Altitude Detection Radars (低空探测雷达)
